audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text and wants.foe[2] call Tahm Kench's ultimate 'Abyssal Voyage'. enemyAbilities.R and the enemyKit both give the real current name as 'Devour' — 'Abyssal Voyage' is a stale/outdated name.
audit.why: enemyKit.abilities R slot text and enemyAbilities.R both confirm 'Devour' as the live ability name. This matches the calibration example pattern (fabricated/outdated ability names shipping to the page).
audit.corrected: Replaced 'Abyssal Voyage' with 'Devour' in both fields, keeping the roam/gank-via-swallow framing which is accurate for Devour used on an ally.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart's two layers disagree at levels 3 and 4-5: content win[2]/win[3] say 'Skill' (matching whys[2]/whys[3], which describe an even trade once his Q-W stun engage is online), but full phases[2]/[3].side both still say 'Hwei'.
audit.why: whys[2]: 'Level 3 evens to skill as his Q-W stun engage comes online.' whys[3]: 'Levels 4-5 stay skill: the trade hinges entirely on dodging Tongue Lash.'
audit.corrected: Moved phases[2].side and phases[3].side to Skill and rewrote each .why to match, since win[2]/win[3] already held the correct verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Abyssal Dive as matchup-defining but has no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and never mentions that his R (Devour) is gated by 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste from Q hits rather than a normal cooldown.
audit.why: Kit gives real numbers: Abyssal Dive (W) is 21/20/19/18/17s; Devour (R) has 0 base cooldown but requires 3 stacks of the passive, which only build from landed Q hits.
audit.corrected: Added the W cooldown range and the stack-gating mechanic for R to breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: His R (Abyssal Voyage) is a roam/gank tool, not lane pressure; keep vision on flanks and your own R plus long poke keeps him from ever landing a clean Tongue Lash into Devour.
edits.after: His R (Devour) is a roam/gank tool, not lane pressure — he swallows an ally to reposition; keep vision on flanks and your own R plus poke stop him landing Tongue Lash into it.

edits.before: Roam with Abyssal Voyage when you overextend
edits.after: Roam with Devour (swallow) when you overextend

edits.before: Full palette: EE fear or EQ root into QQ — the support slot's longest pick kit.

edits.before: Mark-detonate the margins and bank Manaflow — the chip war is a gallery show.

edits.before: - Tahm Kench Abyssal Dive: matchup-defining — His re-engage and his escape — all-in only while it is down. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your E fear paint answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Tahm Kench's Abyssal Dive (W) is 21s early, 17s at max — his re-engage and escape, all-in only while it's down. - Your E fear paint answers one disaster per cooldown. - Devour (R) needs 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste from Q — track stacks, not cooldown.
